header: Star Fox 64's extended plan for play_page.mjs, at most 5 minutes with every timeout counted, for when a longer play
than the regular one (tools/play_plan.json) is needed: the launcher, Load ROM once the page has its shader list
(Chrome builds the whole list behind the launcher and says when it is done, and a click while it builds is lost;
Firefox builds none there, and says so as the launcher comes up), the title, the main menu's Main Game, the Lylat map
(Start skips its prologue, A picks Corneria) and Corneria the way a player starts it, a need that it is playing, then
25 s of Corneria with A held down and the shields kept full (tools/shader_survey.js's fireFor,
patches/shader_survey.c's invincible). Then two more levels the way the shader plan starts them (the survey's
level(), the game's own state change, since a player gets to them only by finishing the ones before; each a need
that the level asked for is playing), 20 s each with A held: Meteo in space and Katina's all-range battle. The
Arwing flies on rails or by itself, so nothing here is timed on the game's clock.
